title: SCE is restoring our power
text:
⚡ Power coming back — our circuit (Orion)
SCE is turning our power back on; crews inspect the lines first, so some streets come back before others. If yours is already on, SCE’s map just hasn’t caught up. SCE’s estimate at 9:50 PM: back by Sat, Oct 17, 5 AM.
Downed line? Stay away and call 911.
SCE status: sce.com/outagemap
Live info: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
